decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to control the game by using cards like Lightning Bolt and Wish to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up for a win condition with Scapeshift and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. The deck aims to ramp up mana quickly with cards like Search for Tomorrow and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, allowing for big plays with Primeval Titan and The One Ring. The deck utilizes lands like Cinder Glade and Dwarven Mine to maximize the potential damage from Valakut triggers, securing victory through overwhelming the opponent with burn damage.

The key idea behind this deck is to quickly establish board presence with efficient threats like Murktide Regent, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck aims to be proactive and aggressive, using cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to clear the way for its creatures to deal damage. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Preordain and Expressive Iteration to help find the right cards and maintain card advantage.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief, while also utilizing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to pressure the opponent early on. The deck also includes removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to maintain board control. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide recursion for key creatures, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Orcish Bowmasters offer additional ways to generate card advantage and dominate the battlefield. Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger serves as a powerful finisher to close out games quickly.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage. The deck aims to control the board using efficient removal like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt, while maintaining card advantage with spells like Memory Deluge and Archmage's Charm. The inclusion of versatile cards like Shark Typhoon and Snapcaster Mage allows for flexibility in responding to threats. With a strong mana base and a variety of control options, this deck seeks to outlast the opponent and eventually win the game through incremental advantage.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by countering spells, removing threats, and drawing cards, while utilizing powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to win the game. The key concept revolves around using The One Ring, Otawara, Soaring City, and Lórien Revealed to gain advantages, protect key pieces, and establish dominance on the battlefield. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents through a combination of control elements and powerful synergies, ultimately leading to a victory through card advantage and overwhelming board presence.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly putting pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Ragavan and Murktide Regent, backed up by a suite of disruptive spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell. The deck also includes card draw and selection like Expressive Iteration and Preordain to help maintain momentum. The land base is designed to ensure consistent access to the deck's powerful spells while also enabling the graveyard synergy of Unholy Heat. This deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize, utilizing a mix of aggression and control elements.

This Rakdos Aggro deck aims to quickly disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief while deploying aggressive threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The deck utilizes powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate to control the board, along with synergistic cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice to protect its creatures. The strategy revolves around applying early pressure, disrupting the opponent's game plan, and finishing off the game with efficient threats and removal spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on disruption and aggression, utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters to quickly close out the game. The deck also includes some removal and protection spells like Terminate and Undying Malice to ensure its threats can get through and deal damage efficiently. With a mix of hand disruption, efficient creatures, and removal spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly.

The main concept of this combo - Hammer Time deck is to quickly assemble the Colossus Hammer combo and take advantage of the synergy between Puresteel Paladin and equipment cards. Using cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Steelshaper's Gift, the deck aims to cheat out and equip Colossus Hammer onto small creatures like Ornithopter, allowing for explosive damage output. The deck also includes alternative win conditions such as Inkmoth Nexus and Sword of Fire and Ice. With efficient tutoring and card draw, as well as protection spells like Sigarda's Aid, the deck focuses on aggressive and explosive plays.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and utilizing the Cascade mechanic to quickly deploy threats onto the battlefield. By casting spells like Dead / Gone and Violent Outburst, you can trigger Cascade effects to bring out powerful creatures like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent. The deck also includes countermagic like Force of Negation to protect your board and disrupt your opponent's game plan. With a mix of removal, card advantage, and hard-hitting threats, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly and efficiently.

The key concept of this deck is to utilize the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant) to assemble a powerful mana base that allows for the quick ramping up to casting high-cost colorless spells like Karn Liberated, Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck focuses on controlling the board with removal spells like Oblivion Stone and countermagic such as Warping Wail while searching for key pieces with cards like Expedition Map and Ancient Stirrings. Boseiju, Who Endures and Cityscape Leveler provide additional utility and protection for the deck.

This deck focuses on quick aggression and disruption while maintaining a solid board presence. By efficiently removing threats with cards like Vindicate and Thoughtseize, as well as utilizing cards like Stoneforge Mystic to search for equipment like Shadowspear and Kaldra Compleat, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents. The inclusion of cards like Solitude and Grief provide additional disruption and removal options, while the mana base allows for consistent access to both colors of mana needed for the deck to function effectively.

The deck focuses on utilizing various efficient creatures and removal spells to put pressure on the opponent quickly. It also includes cards that provide additional value and flexibility, such as Thoughtseize for disruption and Urza's Saga for generating tokens and tutoring for key artifacts. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion allows for additional mana acceleration and a backup plan for casting spells. This Golgari Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of creature aggression and targeted removal.

This deck focuses on maintaining a fast-paced aggressive strategy with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by efficient spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board and push through damage. Counterspells and disruptive cards like Spell Snare and Spell Pierce help protect the deck's threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes card advantage with cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to stay ahead in resources.Overall, this deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain tempo to secure a quick victory.

This deck is centered around creating a fast and aggressive strategy using creatures with high power and low cost. The key concept is to quickly deal damage to the opponent's life total by playing efficient creatures like Wild Nacatl, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Territorial Kavu. The deck also utilizes spells like Lightning Bolt, Stubborn Denial, and Chained to the Rocks to control the opponent's board and protect its own creatures. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Scion of Draco adds additional power to the deck, while the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides a powerful ability and adds consistency to the deck's mana base.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using cards like Amulet of Vigor, Arboreal Grazer, and Primeval Titan to eventually combo off with Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Primeval Titan's land searching abilities. The key strategy is to use Primeval Titan to search for lands that deal damage, while generating multiple land drops per turn to set up a lethal combo. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga and Expedition Map to tutor for key pieces, enhancing its consistency and power level in the mid to late game.
